user.title: Heating Assistant – Site Settings
user.description: Configure the basic settings for Heating Assistant. Room and heat-source definitions are provided in configuration.yaml.

data.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature sensor entity ID (leave blank to use HA default)
data.weather_entity: Weather forecast entity ID (leave blank to disable forecast)
data.update_interval: Control time step (seconds, 60–3600) — how often the MPC re-solves and applies actions (ZOH duration = EKF step = OCP step)

data.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature sensor (optional when weather forecast is set)
data.weather_entity: Weather forecast (optional; either this or outdoor temperature sensor is required)
data.update_interval: Control update interval (seconds, 60–3600) — how often the system recalculates heating control
data.sigma_w: Model variability tolerance — higher values let the system adapt faster to changing conditions
data.sigma_v: Temperature sensor uncertainty (°C) — reflect your sensor's accuracy
data.sigma_b: Calibration drift tolerance — higher values allow sensor calibration to drift over time
data.window_open_debounce: Window open delay (seconds) — sensor must stay open this long before activating window mode
data.window_open_close_settle: Window close delay (seconds) — sensor must stay closed this long before leaving window mode
data.window_open_q_inflation: Open-window uncertainty multiplier — higher values make the controller more cautious when a window is open

data.horizon: Look-ahead time (steps) — 100 steps ≈ 25 hours at 15-min intervals
data.tracking_weight: Setpoint tracking importance — 0 = comfort range only, higher = stricter setpoint control
data.energy_weight: Energy efficiency preference — higher values reduce heating costs but may sacrifice comfort
data.smoothing_weight: Comfort smoothing — higher values reduce rapid heating/cooling cycles
data.soft_constraint_weight: Comfort corridor flexibility — higher values strictly enforce the comfort temperature range
data.terminal_weight: End-of-period behavior weight — controls heating behavior as prediction ends

data.name: Room name
data.room_size: Approximate room size (affects estimated thermal mass)
data.building_age: Approximate building construction period (affects estimated insulation)
data.envelope_tightness: Building air tightness — leaky buildings lose more heat from wind
data.comfort_offset: Comfort range (±°C from setpoint) — temperature can vary within this band

data.name: Heater name
data.heater_entity: Heater control switch (Home Assistant switch entity)
data.cop_rated: Heat pump rated COP at reference temperature (higher = more efficient)
data.min_power: Heat pump minimum output (watts) — 0 = no minimum
data.turn_off_deadband: Turn off threshold (°C above setpoint) — 0 = disabled
data.emitter_time_constant: Response time lag (seconds) — radiators ~600s, fan coils ~60s, resistive ~0s

error.duplicate_room: A room with this name already exists.

simulate_thermal_response.name: Simulate thermal response
simulate_thermal_response.description: Run a standalone thermal simulation showing how a room responds to constant heating power.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Name of the room to simulate.

heating_power.name: Heating power
heating_power.description: Constant thermal power applied to the room (W).

set_schedule_enabled.name: Suspend or resume comfort schedule
set_schedule_enabled.description: Suspend or resume the comfort schedule for a room (or all rooms when none is specified). Useful for one-off exceptions to a sleep / setback schedule.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Optional room name. Leave blank to apply to all rooms.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: True to resume the schedule, false to suspend it.

estimate_parameters.name: Estimate thermal parameters
estimate_parameters.description: Back-calculate thermal_mass and r_external from an observed heating experiment.

heating_power.name: Heating power
heating_power.description: Constant thermal power applied during the experiment (W).

initial_temp.name: Initial temperature
initial_temp.description: Room temperature at the start of the experiment (°C).

final_temp.name: Final temperature
final_temp.description: Room temperature at the end of the experiment (°C).

regenerate_dashboard.name: Regenerate Lovelace dashboard
regenerate_dashboard.description: Build a complete per-room Lovelace dashboard from the current Heating Assistant configuration. Returns the YAML in the response and optionally writes it to <config>/dashboards/.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return YAML only, do not write a file or create a notification.

filename.name: Output filename
filename.description: Plain filename (no path) inside <config>/dashboards. Defaults to heating_assistant.yaml.

compute_loglik_slice.name: Compute log-likelihood slice
compute_loglik_slice.description: Evaluate the CD-EKF PED log-likelihood on a (log C, log R_ext) grid centred on the room's current MLE. Drives the Diagnostics dashboard's likelihood-landscape card.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Room whose parameters should be sliced.

n_grid.name: Grid points
n_grid.description: Number of grid points per axis (odd preferred).

span_log.name: Half-width (log)
span_log.description: Half-width of the slice in log-units. 1.0 ≈ factor 2.7.
